newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Commerce and banks'stocks bring down bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Commerce and banks'stocks bring down bourse index.

text.p: Falling shares in the banking and commerce sectors pushed down the Mauritius bourse index, Semdex which eased 0.85 points on Monday to 381.47, brokers said.
Turnover amounted to 29.22 million rupees on 2,299,094 shares from 11.63 million rupees on 561,231 shares on last Friday.
One broker said the stock market remained uncertain following the recent break-up of the Labour-MMM governing alliance.
In the banking sector, State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) eased 10 cents to 11.80 rupees on 2,200,550 shares and Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) was stable at 88.50 rupees on 20,081 shares.
"SBM accounted for about 88 percent of the volume traded on the stock market to 25.96 million rupees," said another broker.

The broker added that foreign investors had shown selling interest on SBM shares. In the commerce sector, conglomerate Rogers lost 1.00 rupee to 96.00 rupees on 2,155 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) was unchanged at 16.20 rupees on 500 shares.

Hotel-based Sun Resorts was stable at 50.00 rupees on 5,567 shares, New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) also was stable at 37.00 rupees on 6,506 shares and Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) fell 10 cents to 49.00 rupees, but was unquoted.
In the investment sector, Fincorp was stable at 72.00 rupees on 3,993 shares and Policy climbed 10 cents to 4.00 rupees on 29,361 shares. Air Mauritius remained to 38.60 rupees and was not quoted.
